title: Create your account
tagline: Sign up in a minute, as a customer or as a pro
transcript: How to create your Trothen account.
Tap Sign In at the top.
Tap Sign Up.
Choose Customer to book pros. Choose Provider to offer your own work.
Type your full name.
Choose your country.
Choose your county.
Type your phone number.
Type your city or town.
Type your email.
Choose a password of at least 8 characters.
Tap Create Account. We email you a code: type it in to finish.
Already have an account? Tap Sign In instead.

title: Verify your identity
tagline: Send your ID once, so people know you are who you say
transcript: How to verify your identity. You need it before you book or sell.
Tap Verify Now.
Choose your document: a national ID, a passport or a driver's licence.
Type your name exactly as it is printed on the document.
Take a clear photo of the front of your ID.
Then the back, if it has one.
Then a photo of your face, in good light.
Tap Submit for Review. We usually check it within 48 hours and tell you by email.

title: Post a job
tagline: Tell pros what you need, and get a clear price
transcript: How to post a job, so pros near you can offer to do it.
Tap Post a New Job.
Type what you need, for example "cleaning".
Tap the kind of work.
Describe the job: what needs doing and where.
Say who brings the materials.
Tap Next.
Then choose when, where and your price, in L$ or US$, in the next steps.
Pros near you see it and reply. Your payment is held by Trothen until the job is done.

title: Add Mobile Money
tagline: How you pay, and why your money is safe
transcript: How to add Mobile Money to pay on Trothen.
Tap Payments at the bottom.
Tap Add Payment Method.
Choose Mobile Money (or Card).
Type your Mobile Money number.
Choose your network: Orange Money or MTN.
Tap Save Payment Method.
When you pay, Trothen holds the money. The pro is paid only when you confirm the job is done.

title: Book a ride
tagline: A motorbike, keke, car or van, with the fare in L$ before you book
transcript: How to book a ride on Trothen.
Tap More at the bottom.
Tap Rides.
Tap "Use my location" so the driver knows where you are.
Add a landmark, so the driver finds you easily.
Type where you are going.
Tap "Find drivers near me".
Choose a ride. Each shows the fare in L$ and how far away the driver is.
After you book, you see the driver coming on the map. Give your 4-digit PIN only when the plate matches.

title: Find and buy in the Market
tagline: Search, check the details and buy with protection
transcript: How to find and buy something in the Market.
Tap More at the bottom.
Tap Market.
Search for what you want, for example "128gb".
Tap Search.
Tap a good to see it.
Check the details: storage, network, warranty and more.
Tap Add to cart.
Your payment is held until you have the goods.

title: Your cart and checkout
tagline: One cart for every store, with the total before you pay
transcript: How to use your cart.
Tap More at the bottom.
Tap Market.
Tap Add to cart on a good.
Open your cart: tap More, then Cart (or the cart at the top).
Check the goods and the quantities. You can save one for later.
At checkout, choose to collect it or a driver who can carry it. You see the total before you pay.

title: Sell an item
tagline: Put something on sale in the Market, safely
transcript: How to sell something in the Market.
Tap More at the bottom.
Tap Market.
Tap Sell.
Tap Sell an item.
Give it a clear title.
Choose the category. The details buyers look for appear.
Choose the condition.
Type your price.
Confirm that it is yours to sell.
Add photos, then tap Put it on sale. Buyers pay through Trothen, so you are always paid.

title: Messages and calls
tagline: Talk to a pro, a seller or a driver without sharing your number
transcript: How to message or call someone on Trothen.
Tap Messages at the bottom.
Tap a conversation.
Type your message.
Tap Send.
Or tap the microphone to send a voice message.
Call or video call in the app. Nobody sees your phone number.

title: Your data and your account
tagline: Download your data, sign out everywhere, or close your account
transcript: How to look after your account and your data.
Tap More at the bottom.
Tap Settings.
Lost your phone? Tap "Sign out of all devices".
Download a copy of everything Trothen holds about you, in one file.
You can also close your account here. Your data is then removed.

title: Add a good to your store
tagline: Photos, price, details and sizes, the way buyers want them
transcript: How to add a good to your store.
Tap More at the bottom.
Tap My Store.
Tap + Add a good.
Give it a clear name: what it is, the model, the colour.
Choose L$ or US$.
Type the price.
Take or choose a photo. Up to four.
Choose the Market category.
Fill in the details buyers look for, like storage,
the SIM,
and whether it is unlocked.
Tap Save. A store manager checks it before buyers see it.

title: Deliver for stores and the Market
tagline: Your vehicle, your range, and fares in L$
transcript: How to get delivery jobs as a driver.
Tap More at the bottom.
Tap Deliveries.
Choose what you deliver with.
For a motorbike, keke, car or van, Trothen's L$ fares are used, with examples.
Choose the longest trip you will take.
Tap Save. You are offered deliveries your vehicle can carry.
At the store and at the door, enter the code and take a photo. You are paid when the buyer has it.

title: Business tools
tagline: Expenses, quotes and invoices for your work
transcript: How to keep your business records on Trothen.
Tap More at the bottom.
Tap Business Tools.
Tap Expenses.
Add each expense with a photo of the receipt.
Tap Quotes & estimates.
Write a quote for a customer. When they agree, turn it into an invoice with one tap.
